title: Generic affect lexicon
definition: Broad affect labels replace situated evidence or repeat emotion already made legible.
evidenceNeeded: Emotion-term concordances plus redundant-evidence review.
firstIntervention: Restore character-specific attention or action; retain useful direct naming.
pairedOvercorrection: Affective opacity and a blanket ban on emotion.
noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.

title: Adjectival varnish
definition: Evaluative modifiers decorate generic objects and actions without changing interpretation.
evidenceNeeded: Modifier concordances and a deletion test for changed inference.
firstIntervention: Repair weak selection or relations before substituting fancy adjectives.
noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.

title: Synonym cycling
definition: Near-synonym rotation conceals repeated information or destabilizes a natural referent.

firstIntervention: Retain natural naming; cut duplicated informational work.
noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.

title: Connective defaulting

noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.

noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.

title: Cliché image pool

noActionRule: Preserve an intentional effective form. Without evidence of displaced work, report licensed, uncertain or unassessed rather than rewriting.
